_doc: Waystation contracts (ADR-0039): templates the trader's board deals out by the day; each offer picks its building from target (tier band, distance from the post). Story quests name their targets in objectives.

defs.name: Clear a building
defs.briefing: The Program wants {building} emptied: every Hollowed in it put down and its stores searched. {distance} out.

defs.name: Clear a building
defs.briefing: {building} has to be cleared before a survey team goes in: every Hollowed, and its stores searched. {distance} out.

defs.name: Clear a hard building
defs.briefing: Nobody has come back from {building}. Clear it and search its stores. {distance} out. Hazard pay.

defs.name: Recover a Program cache
defs.briefing: A survey team left a sealed cache in {building} and didn't come back for it. Bring it here. {distance} out.

defs.name: Recover a Program cache
defs.briefing: There's a Program cache in {building}, deep inside. Bring it back sealed. {distance} out.

defs.name: Hold a cache
defs.briefing: A drone set a relay cache down by {building}. Its beacon draws them. Hold it until the uplink finishes. {distance} out.

defs.name: Hold a cache
defs.briefing: A relay cache by {building} has to upload. Everything for half a kilometre will hear it. Hold it. {distance} out.
